run_cs_gan_training: run the compressed sensing GAN training script on mnist or cifar datasets
review_main_training_loop: review the main function that sets up the CS-GAN training loop with hooks and sessions
build_cs_model: build a CS model instance using the cs.CS class with a metric net and generator
create_data_processor: create a DataProcessor instance to preprocess and postprocess training image data
export_reconstructions: export reconstructed images to disk using the FileExporter class during training
